lm: Every conversation becomes one connected memory. Thirty K at discovery. IT at the demo. Fifty K at commercials. Link keeps the whole story.
lc: During the call, Cue sits at the top of your screen. Ask it anything, or press command return, and it reads the conversation for you.
ld: On your Mac, just hold one key and talk. Your words are typed at the cursor, in any app.
lp: Your conversations stay yours. Link never trains AI on them, and you can export everything, any time.
